records.quote:
For Robie was the logical conclusion of the development of vending
machines. All the earlier ones had stood in one place, on a floor or
hanging on a wall, and blankly delivered merchandise in return for
coins, whereas Robie searched for customers.
records.paraphrase: Robie is presented as a mobile sales robot that actively seeks out customers, unlike stationary vending machines.

records.quote:
Robie radared the crowd, found that it surrounded him solidly, and
stopped.
records.paraphrase: Robie uses radar to detect the surrounding crowd.

records.quote:
But the customer had run away, screaming, and Robie never ran after
customers
records.paraphrase: A seared survivor flees in terror while Robie continues its sales routine.

records.quote:
if
they had any money and foresight enough to see that sales robots would
eventually be on every street and highway in the country.
records.paraphrase: The story projects that sales robots will eventually be on every street and highway.

records.quote:
But Robie had gone off to peddle Poppy Pop to the members of a rescue
squad which had just come around the corner, more robotlike in their
asbestos suits than he in his metal skin.
records.paraphrase: Robie leaves to sell products to a rescue squad, who seem more robotic than the machine.

records.quote:
The winking
windows shattered tier by tier, became black holes. The walls bent,
rocked, cracked.
records.paraphrase: The blast shatters windows and damages building walls throughout the area.

records.quote:
the silver-green bud
bloomed above Manhattan into a globular
orange flower. The skyscrapers grew brighter and brighter still, the
brightness of the inside of the Sun.
records.paraphrase: An explosion blooms over Manhattan with intense sunlike brightness.

records.quote:
He was the demonstration
model of a line of sales robots to be manufactured by Shuler Vending
Machines, provided the public invested enough in stocks to give the
company capital to go into mass production.
records.paraphrase: Robie is explained as a demonstration model of a sales robot line dependent on stock investment for mass production.

records.quote: "Give me a dime," Robie said.
records.paraphrase: Robie demands payment before performing a service for the frightened child.

records.quote:
in that purple-dark, a
silver-green something, the color of a bud, plunged down at better than
three miles a second.
records.paraphrase: A fast object descends from high above toward the city at over three miles a second.

records.quote: "Help me, Robie," she said. "I want my mother."
records.paraphrase: A surviving little girl pleads with Robie for help finding her mother.

records.quote:
His reference silhouettes were not
good enough to let him distinguish the sex of children, so he merely
repeated, "Hello, youngster."
records.paraphrase: Robie relies on reference silhouettes for identification, which limit his ability to distinguish children's sex.

records.quote:
The crowd around Robie bloomed, too. Their clothes puffed into petals
of flame. Their heads of hair were torches.
records.paraphrase: The crowd is engulfed in flames as clothing and hair ignite.

records.quote:
The silver-green was a newly developed paint that
foiled radar.
records.paraphrase: A newly developed radar-foiling paint conceals the incoming object.

records.quote:
It was wonderful to be alive and watching Robie on such an exciting
day.
records.paraphrase: The narration highlights the crowd's carefree enjoyment just before the disaster.

records.quote:
"Good day, sir," Robie said. "Would you care for a smoke? A truly cool
smoke? Now I have here a yet-unmarketed brand...."
records.paraphrase: Robie offers sales pitches to a burned survivor, contrasting its programmed behavior with the horror around it.

criteria.rationale: Radar detection and a newly developed radar-foiling paint invoke real scientific principles, but these function more as technological details than as materially represented scientific facts or theories driving the story.

Robie, the mobile sales robot, is the central invention of the story; his engineered capabilities (radar, reference silhouettes, automated sales routines) define the setting, action, and grim ironic outcome.

The story is set in a speculative near future with mobile sales robots projected for every street, weather-controlled air, and references to the 'Persian War' and 'Hot Truce' over Pakistan, establishing a future setting.

The story extrapolates the development of vending machines to its 'logical conclusion' in an autonomous sales robot, then develops the consequence of such mindless commercial automation persisting absurdly amid nuclear catastrophe.

Robie's scanning and identification are automated machine routines, not observation, hypothesis, testing, or evidential revision by any agent. No character engages in systematic inference to drive understanding.

The setting is Times Square, Manhattan. References to Mars and space comics are decorative branding; there are no other planets, dimensions, cosmic environments, or visitors from them materially present.
A nuclear explosion devastates Manhattan, incinerating the crowd and shattering buildings; this large-scale catastrophe is actual and causally central to the story's climax and ironic outcome.

candidates.description: Robie, a mobile autonomous sales robot that actively seeks out customers, radars crowds, dispenses merchandise, and represents the logical extrapolation of vending-machine technology into a projected commercial future where such robots populate every street.

novelty.rationale: Robie is explicitly framed as the logical conclusion of vending-machine development, a mobile sales robot that searches for customers rather than standing in place, projected to become ubiquitous on every street and highway. This represents a systematic, world-altering commercial-technological difference from the empirical norm.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The story provides a coherent, immanent, nonsupernatural account: radar-based crowd sensing, reference-silhouette identification with acknowledged limitations, under-scanners for level detection, recorded voice, and a business model dependent on stock investment and mass production. The logic is internally consistent and rationalized.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: Robie governs the whole narrative: the story is structured around his sales behavior before and, crucially, after the nuclear blast, where his mechanical persistence in peddling wares amid horror carries the story's central satirical logic. The nuclear catastrophe, though world-altering, functions as the backdrop against which Robie's commercial single-mindedness becomes the overriding narrative point.

estrangement.rationale: The reader-facing contrast is sharpest when Robie continues delivering sales pitches to burned survivors and demands a dime from a lost child amid the devastation, estranging the reader from consumer-capitalist automation by rendering its indifference monstrous. The rescue-squad comparison inverts human and machine.

candidates.description: A surprise nuclear (or equivalent) attack delivered by an object coated in newly developed radar-foiling paint, plunging at over three miles a second and detonating over Manhattan with sunlike brightness that incinerates the crowd.

novelty.rationale: A city-annihilating nuclear-scale strike is a world-altering catastrophe that transforms the storyworld from bustling Times Square to a landscape of the dead, a totalizing difference in the story's condition.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The strike is rationalized with a coherent nonsupernatural account: a newly developed radar-foiling paint conceals the object, which descends at a specified velocity and detonates with described blast, heat, and structural effects consistent with nuclear physics of the imagined Cold War setting.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The blast is a decisive plot event and reshapes the storyworld, but it functions primarily as the setting shift that exposes Robie's mechanical indifference; the overriding narrative logic remains centered on Robie's continued sales behavior rather than on the attack itself. Its centrality is real but subordinated to the robot satire.

estrangement.rationale: The abrupt shift from carefree crowd enjoyment to bodies bloomed into petals of flame estranges the reader by juxtaposing consumer leisure with sudden atomic annihilation.
